raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the director by relying on a misleading SERP snippet and not clicking through to verify authoritative sources, conflating “The Last Horror Movie” (2003, directed by Julian Richards) with “The Last Horror Film” (1982, directed by David Winters). This failure to disambiguate and confirm led to selecting the wrong person and thus the wrong birthplace.
